msg: if the multiple is x1 chose the same side as you had chosen previously (Left or right) however if you end up with 0 or 1 mushroom then choose the opposite side for x1, if it is a multiple x5 then choose the opposite side. e.g. x5 choose right side (get 20 mushrooms) x1 choose right again (get 5 mushroom) x 5 choose left (get 30 mushroom) x 1 choose left (get 6 mushroom) x1 choose left (get one/zero mushroom) x 1 choose right side. click as quick as you can as that also helps.
